main.description: Everyone ever granted membership, resolved from the registry space: each DID's latest event by TID, counting only events whose author was a current admin at the event's time. Callable by a current admin, or by a service presenting a token from a MEMBERS_TOKEN_* script variable. For the raw grant and revocation log, use syncMembers.

token.description: A service token. Carried as a parameter because HappyView gates procedures behind DPoP authentication, so callers should reach this endpoint over an internal address, keeping the token out of any edge or CDN log.

tier.description: The tier of the latest grant. Missing only on grants written before tiers were required.

grantedAt.description: When the latest grant was written.

revokedAt.description: When membership was revoked, on inactive members.
